lesson.title: Series Engine and Bible Design
lesson.overview: Learn how a recurring television story system can generate distinct episodes, then capture stable creative information in a concise working series reference document.
objectives: Distinguish the recurring series system from the pilot plot.
Generate varied episode ideas from the same story foundation.
Separate established story information from future possibilities.

sections.heading: Recurring story system
paragraphs: Identify the characters, relationships and circumstances that can keep producing new episode problems.

sections.heading: Episode variety
paragraphs: Generate several distinct episode ideas and compare what each one activates.

sections.heading: Working series reference
paragraphs: Record concise information that helps preserve continuity and generate future story.

sections.heading: Document purpose
paragraphs: Keep the internal creative reference separate from changing external presentation expectations.

definitions.meaning: The repeatable story system that can generate distinct future episodes.
A concise premise for exploring a possible episode.
A working series reference for durable story logic and continuity.

example.title: Harbor Watch
example.text: A ferry-terminal drama generates different episode ideas from weather, visitors, family obligations and workplace decisions while preserving the same central relationships.

checklist: The recurring system can generate more than one kind of episode.
Episode ideas remain recognizably part of the same series.
Established information is distinct from possible future ideas.
The working reference stays concise and useful.
mistakes: Treating the pilot plot as the whole series system.
Repeating the same episode problem without meaningful variation.
Letting the reference document become too large to use.
lesson.exercise: Write the recurring series system in two sentences, then create five short episode ideas. Mark which relationship or story rule each idea activates. Finish by listing established information separately from future possibilities.

companionItems.title: Five-episode engine test
companionItems.purpose: Generate five distinct episode premises to test whether the engine produces repeatable conflict without repetition.
